verdict.rationale: Jan is an AI assistant app whose docs say it can work autonomously on your files ("files, commands, and web research"; agents that "read files, manage calendars"). It can also pull in data sources through MCP integration with per-call tool approval, so AI analysis of user data happens inside the product. However, nothing describes dedicated insight or suggestion features over user data, such as document Q&A/RAG, summaries or proactive recommendations, so delivery of the story's "insights and suggestions" is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit document/data-analysis or RAG feature docs, proactive insight or suggestion capabilities, hands-on or independent corroboration of file-based analysis quality.
